date_scope_check.qualification_retained: The December 6, 2024 formal restriction and contemporaneous road interruption followed renewed strikes. December 2 vehicle passage predates this episode and cannot end it. Reports of a December 13 opening lack sufficient vehicle/category detail to establish a matching endpoint; one-way pedestrian movement into Syria was documented by January 2. UNHCR regional flash update 30, dated June 6, 2025, reports that Arida resumed traffic on June 3 for Syrian and Lebanese nationals in private vehicles. On-scene June 3 reporting documents passenger and taxi activity, while a General Security officer says goods trucks still could not use the temporary route. June 3 is therefore a scoped passenger-vehicle restoration; cargo remains separate. Earlier exceptions and the insufficiently specified December opening prevent an uninterrupted all-traffic December–June closure or numeric duration.
date_scope_check.review_limit: No dates, unknown reopenings, duration classifications or continuity assumptions changed by this geographic review.
